notes: WELDED SOURCE: first `blender -b --factory-startup --python tools/jt-fit/weld.py -- <jt-models>/saddle.glb <scratch>/welded/saddle.glb --faces=60000`, then run fit.py with <scratch>/welded as the src dir (the raw source's split vertices shred under decimate). The Pigcraft saddle only: no stand in the source, so it sits on the floor (0.65 m tall in the 1.2 m box), fitted by width 0.5 (its length runs up/down stage, the horn toward the house). It is a Western saddle: the horn is part of the one mesh and stays; the lariat and reins stay. Bridle not joined (fit.py takes one source).
